evidence.description: Housing Ombudsman determination records the resident's complaint history, repair reports, and landlord response.

case.facts: The resident reported a leak coming from the loft on 31 October 2023 causing mould to form on the ceiling. He reported the leak again on 14 November 2023 and told the landlord that he had mould all around his property. The resident complained to the landlord on 4 December 2023 that the issues he reported were not taken seriously and the damp in the property was worsening. The landlord’s response to the resident’s reports of: A leak from the roof including damaged loft insulation. Damp and mould. We have also investigated the landlord’s response to the resident’s complaint.
